summary: Tested the category rename and universes regrouping on both backend and frontend. Backend: 22/22 pytest pass. /api/categories returns the 10 ids with the new titles, correct group/sort_order, the exact expected counts and no 'soon' entries. All 10 palier overviews return 7 paliers. The admin's cinema progress (paliers 6+7, 20/20) is intact, and user_paliers still holds 2 rows before and after. The cinema leaderboard still lists Admin. Leaderboards and questions for culture-40-ans and chansons respond 200. The weekly challenge and its history show the new titles because the startup sync updated category_title. Frontend: the landing page has the 3 universes in order. Par époque reads [culture-70-ans, Bientôt Années 80, culture-40-ans, Bientôt 2010]. Intemporels has 5 cards in the right order. Nostalgie is one card with total 401 and 3 links to /decouvrir/{objets-antan,annees-50-60,chansons}, and those pages load. The Découvrir links are unchanged. The new section title and paragraph are present. Over 6 reloads, the hero demo and #demo questions always came from the 4-question list and were never the same; answering shows feedback and the explanation. On the dashboard, the 3 universes and the card order inside each are correct. The Bientôt cards are DIVs that are not inside a link and have no buttons; clicking one does not navigate. Play buttons for culture-40-ans and chansons start the quiz with 4 options. All 10 parcours pages show 7 paliers. Text scan: no 'Génération 40/70' or 'Neuf univers' on landing, dashboard, parcours, progression, quiz du jour, challenges, challenges/new, coop/new or leagues. Mobile 360/390 with and without Confort+: no page-level horizontal overflow on landing or dashboard. One pre-existing layout bug: on the dashboard with Confort+ on at 360px, the 'Jouer' button is clipped.

minor.issue: The embedded category.count is the stale stored seed value (e.g. cinema 100), while /api/categories shows the live count (142). Pre-existing, not a regression.
8 historical qa_jobs documents still contain 'Génération ...' text. Admin-only and out of scope, but the startup title sync does not cover this collection.

ui_bugs.issue: The 'Jouer' button overflows to the right of the card (card right=340, play button right=427) and is clipped by overflow-hidden, so only 'J' is visible. Pre-existing footer markup, but it fails test item 10 for Confort+ on mobile. Fix: let the footer row wrap (flex-wrap) or stack the count above the buttons when senior-mode is on or below the sm breakpoint.

design_issues.screen: Landing 'Choisissez votre thème' while categories load
issues: Before /api/categories resolves, Par époque shows only the 2 Bientôt cards, and the Nostalgie card shows '0 questions' with no links (brief flash). Consider hiding the universes or showing skeletons until categories load.
The navbar shows both the public links (Catégories/Essai gratuit/Tarifs/Offrir) and the app links, and the 'Confort +' toggle is cut off at the right edge. Pre-existing, unrelated to this change.

action_items: Fix the clipped 'Jouer' button on dashboard category cards in Confort+ mode at 360px (wrap or stack the footer row).
Optional: show skeletons or hide the landing universes until categories load, to avoid the '0 questions' Nostalgie flash.
Optional: include qa_jobs in the title sync, or leave it as is (admin history).
critical_code_review_comments: demoQuestions.js picks the two questions at module load, so they are random per full page load but stay the same on SPA navigation back to '/'. This matches the spec ('per page load').
The 'Années 80' demo uses Sophie (culture-40-ans mascot) and 'Aujourd'hui' uses Jeanne la Voyageuse (voyages-france). Acceptable, but the mascot/category pairing is a bit arbitrary.
The startup sync with update_many on challenges/coop_challenges/weekly_palier_challenges.category_title is idempotent (filter $ne title) and only touches display titles; ids are unchanged.
groupCategories falls back to 'intemporels' for an unknown or missing group, as specified; Bientôt items stay frontend-only.
